CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Duration__c), 0, VALUE( TEXT( VALUE( LEFT( SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m",""), FIND(":", SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","")) - 1 ) ) ) & "." & RIGHT( "00" & TEXT( VALUE( RIGHT( SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m",""), LEN(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","")) - FIND(":", SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","")) ) ) ) ,2) ) )
CustomField.label: Duration Hours
